bddPilot.configuration.tree.searchRunCap: When running filtered tests, ask for confirmation if more than this many scenarios match (0 = never ask).
bddPilot.configuration.locale.descriptio: Language for BDD Pilot status bar, dashboard, CodeLens, and dialogs. Auto follows VS Code UI language.
bddPilot.configuration.locale.enum.auto: Follow VS Code UI language (Spanish UI → Spanish).
bddPilot.configuration.statusBar.display: Status bar layout: compact (single branded hub, default) or detailed (legacy four items).
Single BDD Pilot hub with stage, mode, and project.
Legacy layout with separate STAGE, mode, running, and project items.
bddPilot.configuration.preRun.bindingGat: Before dotnet test, check step bindings via BDD Guardian resolveStep (requires anghelll.bdd-guardian v0.8.3+).
Disabled — same behavior as before v1.5.
Show a modal for unbound or ambiguous bindings; you can cancel or run anyway.
Block runs with missing (unbound) bindings; ambiguous bindings still allow run anyway.
bddPilot.configuration.run.configuration: Optional dotnet test --configuration (Debug or Release). Empty omits the flag (project default).
bddPilot.configuration.run.noBuild.descr: When true, pass --no-build to dotnet test (skip build; requires a prior successful build).
bddPilot.configuration.run.runSettings.d: Path to a .runsettings file (workspace-relative or absolute). Passed as dotnet test --settings when the file exists.
bddPilot.configuration.diagnostics.exten: Enable extended post-run diagnostics (cloud credentials, X-Ray, API HTTP errors). Off by default for generic Marketplace projects.
bddPilot.configuration.feedback.diagnost: How much of the BDD Pilot diagnostics block to append to the Output channel after a run.
Do not append Pilot diagnostics (dotnet log unchanged).
One-line summary of the top diagnostic (+N more when applicable).
